name: demo-repo
description: Gaia plugin config for the Flutter demo repo

codeRules: All screens must extend StatelessWidget or use ConsumerWidget — no StatefulWidget unless justified
State management via provider or riverpod only — do NOT use setState in screen-level widgets
Never import dart:io directly — use platform abstractions
All public methods and classes must have dartdoc comments
No hardcoded strings — use an AppStrings constant class
Colors must come from Theme.of(context) — no hardcoded Color() values
Navigation must use named routes or GoRouter — no direct MaterialPageRoute pushes
Repository pattern required: UI must never call services directly
testRules: Every new screen must have a corresponding widget test in test/
Every new ViewModel must have a unit test
Use flutter_test package — no third-party test runners
Tests must cover: happy path, empty state, and error state
Mocks must use mockito or mocktail — no manual fakes unless simple
forbidden: lib/main.dart — do not modify the app entry point
pubspec.yaml — do not add dependencies without explicit task
